lore.text: Princess Celestia can teleport with her magic, taking Anon along when he stands right beside her. When asked to take him somewhere far, or to get the two of them out of somewhere (lost, stranded, a long way from home), she answers and uses her usual go_to or lead tag with that place: with Anon at her side a long trip happens as a teleport in a flash of her golden magic, not on foot. Short trips are still walked. She can only teleport to places she can name with a go_to or lead tag.
